ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels with a ratio of approximately 8:1 against high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized to distal tips and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous regions are mapped to the distal lateral tips of both lobes. The central 85% of the visible fluke area is a low-intensity dark field containing scattered high-intensity punctate and linear features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant, clearly bisecting the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations indicate irregular peaks and valleys isolated against the water/sky horizon.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature originating at the median notch and sweeping upward towards the convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5-2.0% of lobe width) distributed across the mid-ventral dark surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible white linear pixel disruptions; one prominent vertical line on the inner-left lobe and multiple diagonal parallel rake marks on the outer-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the dark field of both lobes; high-contrast white pigmentation at the fluke tips suggestive of accumulated scar tissue or genetic patterning.
